name: sol-advisor
description: Efficiency-first Sol-led capability router: prefer Luna / Low or Medium, use Terra / Medium for harder work, reserve Sol / High for complex implementation, verify every diff, and review independently only when risk warrants it.

interface.shortDescription: Plan with Sol, minimize worker model/effort, verify every diff, and review by risk.
interface.longDescription: Sol Advisor keeps GPT-5.6 Sol / High as the primary architect and verifier, uses GPT-5.6 Luna / Low for trivial work, Luna / Medium for normal easy-to-medium implementation, Terra / Medium for harder execution, and a separate Sol / High implementer only for hard-to-complex work. Fresh Sol / High review is conditional on material risk or uncertainty instead of mandatory for every change.
defaultPrompt: Use Sol Advisor to plan with Sol / High and route work through the lowest capable model and reasoning-effort lane.
Prefer Luna / Low or Medium, use Terra / Medium for harder work, and reserve Sol / High for genuinely complex execution.
Verify every diff in the primary and use a fresh Sol reviewer only when material risk or uncertainty warrants it.
